tasks.title: Conversation #89
tasks.transcript:
Man: You going to the craft fair this weekend?
Woman: Yes I love looking at handmade items and unique crafts.
Man: Me, too. I'm hoping to find some nice gifts for my family.
Woman: That's a good idea. I've heard there will be a lot of local artists there.
Man: Great, let's meet up there around 10 AM.

questions.stem: What event are the speakers discussing?
questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：说话者在讨论什么活动？ 定位原文：Man: You going to the craft fair this weekend? 选项分析： A. A music concert 音乐会。对话中未提及音乐或演唱会，所以A选项错误。 B. A craft fair 手工艺品展销会。男士明确提到“craft fair”，女士也提到“handmade items and unique crafts”，所以B选项正确。 C. A food festival 美食节。对话中未提及食物相关活动，所以C选项错误。 D. A book fair 书展。对话中未提及书籍或作者，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What does the man hope to find at the event?
questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：男士希望在这个活动上找到什么？ 定位原文：Man: I'm hoping to find some nice gifts for my family. 选项分析： A. Artwork for his home 装饰家里的艺术品。对话中未提及为自己家里买艺术品，所以A选项错误。 B. Gifts for his family 送给家人的礼物。男士明确说想给家人找些好礼物，所以B选项正确。 C. Food and drinks 食物和饮料。对话中未提及食物饮品，所以C选项错误。 D. Clothes and accessories 衣服和配饰。对话中未提及衣物类商品，所以D选项错误。
